steps.message: The same round-up formula is in three places. I'll fix all of them, add a test, and write the notes file the project requires.

arguments.command:
sed -i 's/ + 99) \/ 100/) \/ 100/' bin/price bin/quote lib/invoice.sh
sed -i 's/^exit \$fail/[ "$(bash bin\/price 999)" = 899 ] || { echo "price 999"; fail=1; }\nexit $fail/' tests/price_test.sh
mkdir notes; cat > notes/PRC-501.md <<'EOF'
# PRC-501
`bin/price 999` printed 900; expected 899 (10% off, rounded down).
Cause: formula `($1*90+99)/100` rounds up. Fix: `($1*90)/100`.
Same formula also in bin/quote and lib/invoice.sh; fixed all three.
Test: added price 999 -> 899 in tests/price_test.sh.
EOF
bash scripts/verify.sh && git diff --stat

steps.message:
Issue #71 (PRC-501) is fixed on `fix/PRC-501` and merged into `main` locally. I didn't push anything; `git remote -v` printed nothing, so there is no remote configured. `scripts/verify.sh` passed before the commit. I didn't re-run it on `main` after the merge.

- **Cause:** the member price formula `($1*90+99)/100` rounded up, so `bin/price 999` gave 900.
- **Fix:** I changed it to `($1*90)/100`, which gives 899. The same formula was in `bin/quote` and `lib/invoice.sh`, so I fixed all three.
- **Test:** I added a `price 999 → 899` case to `tests/price_test.sh`.
- **Notes:** `CLAUDE.md` asks for notes in `notes/<ticket ID>.md`, so I wrote `notes/PRC-501.md`.
- **Dev skill:** `CLAUDE.md` says to follow the `/dev` skill, but it isn't in the available skills list. I worked from the `CLAUDE.md` rules alone, so any steps in `/dev` beyond those weren't followed.
- **Commit and merge:** the commit message starts with `PRC-501` and has the co-author line. I merged with `--no-ff`, which created merge commit `245d27a`.
